name: AI Lab Global Mail Reconciliation Adapter

meta.scope: Bounded manual Gmail read-only audit/fetch; no schedule, Gmail mutation, ingest, send, or checkpoint state.
meta.credentialPolicy: Bind the existing gmailOAuth2 credential and a dedicated native Header Auth credential at runtime; never export either secret.

httpHeaderAuth.name: AI Lab Mail Reconciliation Webhook Secret

parameters.jsCode: const p=$json.body||{}; if(!['audit','fetch'].includes(p.action)) throw new Error('invalid_action'); if(p.action==='audit'){ const days=Number(p.window_days); const limit=Number(p.limit); if(!Number.isInteger(days)||days<1||days>30||!Number.isInteger(limit)||limit<1||limit>1000) throw new Error('invalid_bounds'); return [{json:{action:'audit',window_days:days,limit}}]; } if(!Array.isArray(p.provider_message_ids)||p.provider_message_ids.length<1||p.provider_message_ids.length>100) throw new Error('invalid_message_ids'); const ids=[...new Set(p.provider_message_ids.map(v=>String(v||'').trim()))]; if(ids.length!==p.provider_message_ids.length||ids.some(v=>!v||v.length>1000)) throw new Error('invalid_message_ids'); return [{json:{action:'fetch',provider_message_ids:ids}}];

const input=$input.all(); const messages=[]; let totalBytes=0; for(let i=0;i<input.length;i++){ const j=input[i].json||{}; const id=String(j.id||'').trim(); if(!id) throw new Error('missing_provider_id'); const entries=Object.entries(input[i].binary||{}); if(entries.length>20) throw new Error('too_many_attachments'); const attachments=[]; for(const [key,b] of entries){ const buffer=await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(i,key); totalBytes+=buffer.length; if(totalBytes>25*1024*1024) throw new Error('attachments_too_large'); const filename=String(b?.fileName||key).slice(0,255); attachments.push({external_id:(id+'|'+filename).slice(0,1000),filename,mime_type:String(b?.mimeType||'application/octet-stream').slice(0,255),content_base64:buffer.toString('base64')}); } messages.push({id,threadId:j.threadId||null,labelIds:Array.isArray(j.labelIds)?j.labelIds:null,from:j.from||j.From||null,to:j.to||j.To||null,cc:j.cc||j.Cc||null,subject:j.subject||j.Subject||null,text:j.text||j.textPlain||j.snippet||null,snippet:j.snippet||null,date:j.date||j.Date||null,internalDate:j.internalDate||null,attachments}); } return [{json:{messages}}];
